title: onprem: airgap offline bundle vendor rke2 RHEL9 / AlmaLinux9 support + TUF metadata updates
author: Liam O'Connell
release_notes: Add RHEL9 and AlmaLinux9 as supported kube-distro targets for the on-prem offline installer; update TUF metadata generation and vendored images; include small fixes to post-install networking on RHEL9 kernels.
description: Motivation: customers running RHEL9/AlmaLinux9 with RKE2 requested official support for our air-gapped offline bundles. This PR adds vendor images, TUF metadata updates, and small installer runtime tweaks to enable RHEL9/AlmaLinux9 as a supported target. Changes include: updated vendor bundles for rke2 images (rke2-1.24+), packaging of distro-specific systemd unit templates, TUF metadata re-generation to include new archives, and a fix to the preflight kernel module check on RHEL9 kernels. Checklist: - [x] Add RHEL9/AlmaLinux9 image manifests and tarballs - [x] Update vendor automation scripts and image hash lists - [x] Rebuild TUF metadata and ensure verification succeeds in CI - [x] Add distro-specific systemd templates and post-install hooks - [x] Add integration tests for airgap RKE2 boot on RHEL9 in canary environment Notes: the description of files changed below is high-level; see commits for details. Some vendored images are large; the bundle size increased ~120MB. This PR was validated in our private canary cluster (rke2 on AlmaLinux9) and by running the offline verification in a local airgap container. Related: ENG-3241 (distro support), ENG-3410 (tuf automation).
